initialSnapshot.loader: static loadRepositoryCrosswalk; owner files parsed as TypeScript text and never executed

recordEncoding.mappingRecord: records.mappings[i] = [ownerIndexes, operationKind, objectGroupIndexes, existingDataEffect, occurrenceIndexesWithinMapping, staticCrosswalkMappingIndex, operationalRiskProfileIds]; every record inherits authoritativeStatus UNRESOLVED and sourceChecklistProfile status SOURCE EVIDENCE INCOMPLETE; mapping ID is mappingIds[i]; stable record ID is mapping:<mappingIds[i]>
recordEncoding.additionalOperationRecord: records.additionalOperations[i] = [ownerIndex, category, objectGroupIndexes, existingDataEffect, [staticCrosswalkAdditionalIndex, completeEvidenceIndex], operationalRiskProfileIds]; every record inherits authoritativeStatus UNRESOLVED and sourceChecklistProfile status SOURCE EVIDENCE INCOMPLETE; ID is additionalOperationIds[i]; stable record ID is additional-operation:<additionalOperationIds[i]>
recordEncoding.occurrence: occurrences[i] = [mappingIndex, occurrenceIndexWithinMapping, ownerIndex, [literalLine,literalColumn,operationLine,operationColumn], executionOrder, phase(0=pre-listen;1=post-listen;null=unspecified), callSite, fullSqlSha256]; stable occurrence ID is occurrence:<mappingIds[mappingIndex]>:<occurrenceIndexWithinMapping+1>. Full SQL is staticCrosswalk.mappings[mappingIndex].occurrences[occurrenceIndexWithinMapping].sourceSql. Owner file path/SHA are owners[ownerIndex].source/SHA and inputPins.
recordEncoding.objectGroup: objectGroups[i] = [objectGroupId, membership basis, exact structured identity]; mapping/additional records list their actual group indexes. No arbitrary count-based groups are used.
recordEncoding.evidence: Mapping index points to staticCrosswalk.mappings[index], including canonical evidence, dependencies, preconditions, postconditions and rollback. Additional pair points to staticCrosswalk.additionalOperations[pair[0]] and completeEvidence[pair[1]].

catalog.fullSqlRetrieval: For each occurrence, load the indicated staticCrosswalk sourceSql field with loadRepositoryCrosswalk. ownerSourcePath + ownerSourceSha256 pins the full owner source; literalSha256 verifies the complete SQL literal. SQL is intentionally not duplicated or abbreviated in this compact inventory.

operationalRiskProfiles.OP-ORDER-BRANCH-FAILURE: Prove exact reachable branch, source/transaction order, failure propagation and final as well as intermediate postconditions.
operationalRiskProfiles.OP-LOCK-VALIDITY: Characterize lock/timeout behavior, index or constraint validity, partial completion and repair/recovery boundary.
operationalRiskProfiles.OP-BINDING-SECURITY: Compare full function/trigger/policy body, binding, privileges, volatility/security/search_path and dependent objects.
operationalRiskProfiles.OP-LOCK-TIMEOUT-TRANSACTION: Characterize advisory-lock scope, session GUC restoration, transaction/autocommit boundary and failure cleanup.
operationalRiskProfiles.OP-DATA-INVARIANT-COMPENSATION: Prove affected rows/invariants, concurrent writers, business authorization and compensation/restore plan.
operationalRiskProfiles.RECOVERY-RETRY-NOT-PROOF: IF [NOT] EXISTS, retry or suppression alone is not rollback/recovery proof; preserve an approved repair/restore boundary.
